invariants.rationale: The method always constructs a new HoodieWriteMetadata object before returning and never returns null.
clusteringPlan is directly dereferenced in the method and must be non-null along all paths.
schema is passed as an argument and is used for clustering; likely to be required non-null.
instantTime is passed into downstream methods and used for clustering; must be non-null.
The method always sets the write statuses using HoodieListData.eager, so it cannot be null.
